name: RAG-lite Telegram Q&A Bot — Notion/Sheets Knowledge Base + MCP + LangChain
description: Telegram Bot Question → Notion/Sheets Search Rows (RAG-lite Retrieve) → Gemini Generate Answer with Confidence (MCP + LangChain) → Router: Confidence Gate → Telegram Reply or Slack Escalation
modules: Sheets: Search Rows OR Notion: Query Database (Sheets API / Notion API — RAG-lite Retrieve)

note: Knowledge base: 20 Q&As in Sheets/Notion. Prompt: Knowledge: {{Retrieved Q&As}} User Q: {{User Question}} If in KB, answer with confidence 80-100%, if not ESCALATE 0-50%. Output: ANSWER: [text] | CONFIDENCE: [%] | SOURCE: [Q&A]
